title: Minimum Time to Make Array Sum At Most x
summary: Given two 0-indexed integer arrays nums1 and nums2 of equal length, increment each element of nums1 by its corresponding element in nums2 every second.
statement: Given two 0-indexed integer arrays nums1 and nums2 of equal length, increment each element of nums1 by its corresponding element in nums2 every second. After performing these increments, you can set any element of nums1 to zero. Determine the minimum time required to make the sum of all elements in nums1 less than or equal to a given integer x, or return -1 if it is not possible.
constraints: Arrays have equal length up to 1000 and nonnegative values.
Each second first adds nums2 everywhere, then permits one index to be reset to zero.
Return the first time with total at most x, or -1.
hints: For a fixed number of seconds, resets with larger growth should occur later.
Sort by nums2 and use knapsack DP for maximum removed contribution at every reset count.
An exchange argument orders selected growth rates, and the DP considers every selected subset in that order.
editorial: An exchange argument orders selected growth rates, and the DP considers every selected subset in that order.

tests.explanation: Resetting indices in increasing growth-aware order reaches total four after three seconds.
Equal growth rates keep the total above four under every reset schedule.
